race.comment: SEVEN DAYS (4) bounced back to form last start, beaten a length in a BM64 over this course and distance. Fifth up today but can still improve based on previous peaks. Has the edge on this field. DUCK FOR COVER (2) raced on the speed and had his chance but his condition told when resuming in the same race as SEVEN DAYS here a fortnight ago. Scored over 1300m here at the same stage of last prep. Big danger but will need luck from an awkward gate. VITTOZZI (10) was a month between runs when an eye-catching fourth last time out over this trip at Scone, beaten just a length. May race a bit closer this time with the winkers on. Should play a key role. RHYTHM OF THE REIN (6) started favourite and recorded a workman-like win on debut over 1000m here recently. Should improve over the longer trip so he is right in contention. DUBAI ADVENTURE (1) is cherry-ripe at the third run back. One to include in trifectas and first fours.
